# Deterministic Checks (run ONCE, outside the replication channel)

A check whose detection probability is essentially 1 gains nothing from N-fold replication.

**By reference, never by copy.** Read the shared verification contract and apply its detection
grammar and its well-formedness predicate verbatim from that file.

## Checks

1. Anchor and link resolution.
2. Section schema and canonical ordering.
